# Studio Subhra

> Award-winning high-end Indian designer fashion house founded by fashion designer, lecturer, and consultant Subhra Saha. Known for innovative drape engineering, the iconic Denim Saree, sculptural Inspiration Origami collections, Knit Concept Sarees, and contemporary Designer Prêt.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: Studio Subhra
- **Tagline**: Set the Trend
- **Ethos / Motto**: "I don't sell products. I sell my dreams."
- **Founder & Creative Lead**: Subhra Saha (Fashion Designer, Lecturer, Consultant)
- **Official Website**: https://www.studiosubhra.in/
- **Location**: Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- **Contact**: subhraonly@yahoo.co.in | Phone: +91 99030 24696 | WhatsApp: +91 98756 29283
- **Pricing**: Exclusive bespoke pricing / Price on Request with personalized WhatsApp atelier consultations.

## Core Collections
1. **Denim Saree**: "Desi Heritage. Global Attitude." Timeless 6-yard saree silhouette merged with modern distressed, structured, and stonewashed denim. An iconic global-desi statement.
2. **Inspiration Origami**: "Nature × Origami × Fashion." Sculptural geometric folds, accordion drapes, and organic architectural silhouettes handcrafted with sustainable textiles and precision pleating.
3. **Designer Prêt**: Everyday haute luxury and wearable designer silhouettes tailored for modern professionals and contemporary celebrations.
4. **Knit Concept Saree**: "Traditional Roots. Modern Twist." Pioneering the synthesis of flexible, breathable textured knit fabrics with traditional Indian draping techniques for maximum comfort and style.
5. **Ready to Wear (Prêt-à-Porter)**: 24 curated runway silhouettes featuring co-ords, draped gowns, asymmetric cape sets, and modern fusion ensembles available for immediate bespoke order.
6. **Arriving Soon**: Upcoming seasonal couture collections, avant-garde evening wear, and high-fashion previews.
